title: Hoshino Ichika — The Starry Sky I Saw〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What?! This is that park...!
Where we saw that meteor shower! H-How...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And you're here, Miku, which means... This isn't real?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. You touched “somebody's” fragment of a feeling just now, I believe?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In simple terms, this is what it wants to show you... As an incomplete SEKAI of sorts...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry, you'll be able to return to your SEKAI shortly.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Miku said that this is “somebody's” fragment of a feeling but...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem to already know where we are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Didn't I mention how you may be able to find the answer you were looking for?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Since we're here, why don't we go for a little walk?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What do you think? Is it the same park? Is this where you and your friends saw that meteor shower?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Everything looks familiar, but the playground isn't quite the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But the jungle gym is exactly how I remember it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For example, the second step from the bottom... Oh, here! There should be something doodled there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Apparently, this boy from our elementary school drew it, but he used a permanent marker so it's been there ever since.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki and I came here after she started coming back to school, and talked about how this place never really changes after seeing what was left of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You all climbed on top of this jungle gym to see the meteor shower, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew. It may not be the biggest jungle gym, but the view up here certainly is nice...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's the view from up top?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, it isn't quite the same as the real thing... It's different but still the same...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was just thinking about what this all means. The meaning behind what this fragment is showing us, you know?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The meaning behind what we're seeing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. This place must have some sort of meaning since it's so similar to the place from your memories.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And what you said just now may have given me the answer.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This place may be trying to tell us about things that are “different, but still the same”.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I think you'll agree with me when I say how you and the others have gradually changed over time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But this place, the park where it all began, hasn't changed one bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This view and this jungle gym may be trying to represent that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We ourselves may have changed, but our feelings haven't...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
I think I know what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel like I was able to do so much more back then, and I can't do any of that anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Compared to my current self, my past self seemed so much more...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This may sound a bit strange since I don't know what you were like back then...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I refuse to believe that your past self is more amazing than your current self.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, you had the courage to face Honami and Shiho, and tell them exactly how you felt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, you've managed to overcome quite a few other hurdles since then.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Through thick and thin, you persevered and never shied away from those challenges.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You've come so far, Ichika, and I'm sure your past self would agree with me on that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And the part about not being able to do what you used to be able to doesn't seem quite right either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, there's just so much that only the current you is capable of now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You think so?
Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because, “You're the most amazing person ever, Ichi!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?! Oh no, Miku, you too...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wish we could've stayed a little longer and kept watching.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but it was still fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm also glad that I was able to see something so precious.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you.
You and that place taught me something very important today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm still not entirely sure what it is that my current self is truly capable of...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I feel like I can have a little more confidence in myself now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll keep trying my best to write lyrics that reflect who I am.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Great. I'll be looking forward to seeing them, Ichika.
